tasks.title: Expose legacy and administrative operations with partial-effect truth
tasks.goal: Close initial-domain API gaps without hiding supported operations behind contextual unsupported results.
steps: Before any code edit, consume the accepted M-16 capability census and produce an exact batch manifest naming at most one coherent handler family, its schemas, private model projections, files and failure-prefix cases. Register one stable .batch-N child per remaining family in the local plan, with parent exit requiring the full original denominator. The current task is a bounded refinement/batch protocol, not permission for one cross-product sweep.
Walk the exact M-16 census for settings, registry/cache/version/tool, source-conversion, install/reinstall/update/remove/clean and initial lifecycle/domain operations.
Extract remaining CLI-local domain preparation/actions into their owning shared services, using strict schemas and actual per-operation options.

Preserve written/partial/uncertain effect lists on every failure path, including multi-resource materialization that errors before its final report; add one executable external case for each supported row.
positive_cases: Every supported initial administrative/refactor operation has a structured invoke/result path.
A failure after one successful file write reports that write and recovery applicability.
negative_cases: Restrictive schema is advertised but unknown arguments are ignored.
An implemented CLI feature remains an API stub labelled unavailable.
checks: TO CREATE: per-row initial-operation conformance and partial-materialization failure tests.
acceptance: Coverage denominator has no unexplained missing supported initial operation.
Authority and domain behavior match existing implementations rather than a second engine.
tasks.safe_stop: Initial operation rows are either proven or explicitly unimplemented blockers; no false completion.

tasks.title: Read and capture complete retained debugging structures
tasks.goal: Expose stage evidence without acquiring writer ownership, rerunning providers or silently truncating completeness.
steps: Add read-only readers over existing trace/index/IR/domain snapshots; opening retained data must not obtain a writer role, prune retention or recreate missing captures.
Expose configurable stage/detail/filter/sink/retention and streamed export; report absent/evicted/not-captured/redacted/snapshot-failed portions precisely.
Provide solver rejection/selection, compiler transform, lifecycle/effect and artifact evidence views; separate observability completeness failures from unchanged domain execution semantics.
positive_cases: A failed run's retained stages remain readable after process exit.
Full-detail capture streams large structures with explicit policy and progress.
negative_cases: Reading a trace silently reruns an effectful provider or sweeps old records.
An observer failure changes compiler bytes/solver choice or a hardcoded limit is called complete detail.
checks: TO CREATE: no-write retained-reader, failed-capture, streamed-retention and observer-neutrality tests.
acceptance: Each relevant domain model family has an externally addressable stage/provenance representation or exact missing-state reason.
Required proof cannot close when requested evidence was uncaptured.
tasks.safe_stop: Retained captures/export bundles are readable and domain outputs remain unchanged.
